detail: Executable teeth landed (tests/acl2/wire-family-consumer-tests.lisp: host encoding equals the grammar's for every status, the encoder refuses (:bad) a non-decoding cursor and a status carrying one, both decoders refuse the :sized bounds, a short or long report, a carried cursor, a wrong kind; tests/acl2/wire-grammar-tests.lisp: :sized positive, bounds, overrun, underrun, inner refusal). Owed, statement-first: a REACHABLE positive and one removal witness per hypothesis of fn-wf-cs-poll-encode-agrees through defteeth (books/defkeystone.lisp), and for fn-wg-decode-of-encode-sized / fn-wg-encode-of-decode-sized the same.
fix: Add the defteeth forms beside the executable assert-events.
scenario: The keystone could be vacuous if its not-:bad hypothesis were unreachable; the executable positives show it is reachable for every status, but the per-hypothesis removal witnesses are not stated as teeth.
title: proof-owed: statement teeth for fn-wf-cs-poll-encode-agrees and the :sized node's two lemmas
